tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Full-text search over AgentsIndex's Published tools. Returns compact records (name, slug, tagline, url). Fetch depth with get_listing.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One tool in full, as answer-first markdown: the summary, then every question on the sheet with its answer, the vendor's own words for it and the URL that proves it. Identical to /{slug}.md and to the HTML page.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: AgentsIndex's categories with their live listing counts, 0 for one with none yet.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Two tools side by side, as markdown: taglines, pricing, API availability, tags — the researched compare facts, honest about unknowns.

tools.name: get_best_of
tools.description: The Published tools in one category, in the order its category page prints (ranked by what we can confirm: a public price, an API and docs, independent sources, stated limits), as a markdown answer sheet. Payment never moves a row.

Requires consent:true, a real name, a permanent (non-disposable) email, a message of at least 20 chars, and a target (listingSlug OR categorySlug). Returns { ok, delivered }. tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: What a listing owner can buy on AgentsIndex, with prices in US cents (VAT included), each offer's term and what it needs. Keyless. Same answer as GET https://agentsindex.ai/api/agent/catalogue. Listing on AgentsIndex is free and never sold: submit_listing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, submit_listing, my_listings · Private data: search_listings, create_order · Public sink: submit_listing, send_lead, get_quote, create_order, my_listings, subscribe_newsletter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, submit_listing, my_listings · Private data: search_listings, create_order · Public sink: submit_listing, send_lead, get_quote, create_order, my_listings, subscribe_newsletter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
